title: SHARE-seq protocol v2.2
author: Amelia Hall
materials: oligo plates
STE buffer
BioRad PX1 plate sealer
PCR machine

This part occurs only after you have all of the oligo deepwell plates and the Round 1,2,3 linker oligos from IDT. If you don't have these yet, don't proceed with platemaking! The recipe below is for eighteen 96 well plates for each round of barcoding (54 total plates per set of 96 oligos, that's 108 if you're making both plate1 and plate2). We recommend that you use different color PCR plates for each round of each plate. Conveniently, ThermoFisher offers 96 well skirted plates in 6 different colors, search for part number AB2396N (where N=R is red, G=green, Y=yellow, B=blue, O=orange - the base model is clear). Please be sure you purchase part number AB2396, and not AB3396 - those plates have white wells that will make it hard to tell how much fluid is in the well.
Thaw deepwell plates at RT for 20-40 minutes at RT, and spin down before usage to avoid oligo cross-contamination. Can speed the thaw by setting on a thermomixer set to 28ºC if needed.
Using a 12 channel multipipettor:

Make each of the following buffers - note that for large experiments you may need more than one aliquot of these buffers. Dilution buffer Volume (ml) Final Concentration 100% glycerol (wide-bore tips) 500 50% 1M Tris pH 7.5 50 50 mM 5M NaCl 20 100 mM 5mM EDTA 20 0.1 mM 1M DTT 1 1 mM 10% NP-40 10 0.1% H2O 390 Total 1000 5x SMART RT buffer (adapted from smart-seq-3) Volume (ml) Final Concentration (of 5x) 1000mM (1M) DTT 40 40 mM 1M Tris pH 8.3 125 125 mM 100 mM GTP 50 5 mM 5M NaCl 30 150 mM 1M MgCl2 12.5 12.5 mM H2O 742.5 Total 1000 You can also make the NI (see step 28) the day before SHARE. We recommend making a fresh 50mL aliquot for every experiment as a safeguard against RNase contamination.
1.4 Essential SHARE-seq buffers (make the day before performing an experiment)
In the 1.5mL tube, seal, shake in a thermomixer at 500rpm for 30 minutes, 37ºC.
Every 5 minutes, take the entire block off the thermomixer and invert to mix This resets the timer on the thermomixer! So use an external timer to avoid a headache.

Make the following master mix for reverse transcription: Reverse transcription (RT) mix Volume/sample (ml) 5x SMART RT buffer 70 Enzymatic RI 2.19 SUPERase RI 4.38 dNTPs 17.5 100mM RT primer 35 H2O 40.94 50% PEG 35 Maxima H Minus Reverse Transcriptase (add right before RT reaction) 35 Total 240 For each ATAC 25 reaction tube, add 280ul RT mix to 60ul cells/NI-2RI, aliquot 50ul to 7 wells in a 96 well plate. Then, run the RT thermocycler protocol as described below. 50ºC 10 min 8ºC 12 s 3 cycles 15ºC 45 s 20ºC 45 s 30ºC 30 s 42ºC 2 min 50ºC 3 min 50ºC 5 min Total ~41 min
Discard supernatant and add 1mL NID-2RI.
Gently resuspend pellet with 1mL NI-2RI
Using the supernatnant with ATAC fragments from step 95, purify the samples using a Qiagen MinElute PCR purification kit (Qiagen cat #: 28006) as follows:
In new tube, mix sample and 5x volume Qiagen PB buffer (1000ul), then add to MinElute spin column in two batches 2x600ul, spinning, then discarding flowthrough after each addition (as below).

Save the qPCR plate to check qPCR product size on an e-gel. This can be combined with checking the cDNA after amplification. Expect a smear with an average size of 400bp. Nucleosomal banding may be present. A smaller MW band at ~270bp is likely non-nucleosomal, and does not correlate with poor quality. An e-gel of several ATAC libraries We recommend using an e-gel, 2%, and we run these using the ThermoFisher/Invitrogen Snap apparatus . We use the e-gel 50bp ladder .

After PCR reamp, add 1ul of Exonuclease I (NEB cat # M0293L) to each library and place libraries back in thermocycler for “ExoCleanup” program (parameters below) to get rid of excess primer. ExoCleanup 37ºC 15 mins 80ºC 15 mins 4ºC Forever Total ~30 min
Magnetize for 5 minutes
Magnetize until clear

After PCR reamp, add 1ul of Exonuclease I to each library and place libraries back in thermocycler for “ExoCleanup” program to get rid of excess primer. ExoCleanup 37ºC 15 mins 80ºC 15 mins 4ºC Forever Total ~30 min

After confirmation of satisfactory bioanalyzer or tapestation traces, quantify all libraries to be sequenced together (in the same independently addressable lane) using a Kapa quantification kit (Roche cat number: 7960140001). We recommend running reactions in duplicate, using 10ul reactions, loading standards in order of ascending concentration (load NTC, then std6, std5..... std1), and using two dilutions. We first dilute a library 1:1000 in water, then serially dilute 1:1000 again to get a 1:10^6 dilution. We also dilute the 1:1000 again at 1:100 to get a 1:100,000 dilution. Duplicates of both 1:10^6 and 1:100K are used to calculate the concentration of the libraries (these values will be different, that is OK).
The recommended read structure for SHARE-seq

For each sample, mix 60ul cells/nuclei in NI-2RI from the previous step with 240ul PolyA master mix (recipe below), and incubate at 37ºC for 15 minutes in a thermomixer without mixing. (each 1.5mL ATAC tube is a single polyA reaction).

steps.title: Decontaminate Workspace
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment to prevent RNA degradation.

substeps.instruction: Spray the bench and pipettors with RNase zap.
Put on a surgical mask.
Spray gloves with RNase Zap frequently.

steps.title: Order Oligo Plates and Linkers
steps.instruction: Order specific oligos and plates from IDT.

substeps.instruction: Order 96-well deepwell plates for Round 1, 2, and 3 (Plate 1, and optionally Plate 2) at 25nM yield, 100uM concentration, resuspended in IDTE buffer.
Order linker oligos (Round 1, 2, 3) at 1mM (1000uM) concentration in IDTE.
Order blocking oligos (Round 1, 2, 3) at 100uM concentration in IDTE.
Order additional oligos for tagmentation and amplification: Read1, RT_primer, P7, Phosphorylated_Read2, Blocked_ME_Comp, RNA_PCR_primer, and TSO (all at 100uM in IDTE, except P7 at 100nm).
Mix 0.5 mL 1M Tris pH 8.0, 0.5 mL 5M NaCl, 0.1 mL 0.5 M EDTA, and 48.9 mL H2O.

steps.title: Anneal Hybridization Oligo Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare and anneal the 96-well oligo plates for each round.

substeps.instruction: Round 1: Dilute 180μl Round 1 linker (1mM) with 7920μl STE. Mix 80μl diluted linker with 20μl Round 1 oligo (100μM) per well in a 96-well PCR plate.
Round 2: Dilute 216μl Round 2 linker (1mM) with 7371μl STE. Mix 76μl diluted linker with 24μl Round 2 oligo (100μM) per well in a 96-well PCR plate.
Round 3: Dilute 259.2μl Round 3 linker (1mM) with 7047μl STE. Mix 72μl diluted linker with 28μl Round 3 oligo (100μM) per well in a 96-well PCR plate.
Seal plates using BioRad PX1 sealer (180°C for 5s) or BioRad Microseal F foil seals.
Run PCR cycle: 95ºC for 2 min, slow ramp -1ºC/cycle for 1 min per cycle, 20ºC for 2 min, then 4ºC forever (~1h 26 min).
Add 100μl STE to each well, mix 7-8x, and transfer 100μl to a new 96-well plate to create 'stock plates'.
Aliquot 10ul from stock plates into separate colored 96-well plates for each round.
Seal with foil, label, and store at -30ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Tagmentation Adapters
steps.instruction: Order, anneal, and store adapters for cDNA tagmentation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare tagmentation adapter mix in PCR tubes: 26ml 100mM Read1, 26ml 100mM Blocked_ME_Comp, 0.52ml 1M Tris pH 8.0, 0.52ml 5M NaCl (Total 53ml).
Anneal: 85ºC for 2 min, slow ramp -1ºC/cycle for 1 min per cycle, 20ºC for 2 min, then 4ºC forever (~1h 14 min).
Heat 150ul RNase-free 100% glycerol to 65ºC. Make two 50ul aliquots and equilibrate to RT.
Mix each 50ul aliquot of annealed adapter with 50ul glycerol.

steps.title: Wash and Count Fixed Cells
steps.instruction: Process fixed cells or nuclei and determine concentration.

substeps.instruction: Cool swinging bucket centrifuge rotor to 4ºC.

Prepare buffers: NIB (10mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 10mM NaCl, 3mM MgCl2, 0.1% NP40), NI (10mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 10mM NaCl, 3mM MgCl2), NIB-2RI (NIB + Enzymatic RI + SUPERase RI), and NI-2RI (NI + Enzymatic RI + SUPERase RI + 7.5% BSA).
Prepare 1.5mL BSA-coated tubes (add 150ul 7.5% BSA, vortex, remove supernatant, ice, remove residual BSA).
Resuspend fixed pellet in 500ul NI-2RI and transfer to BSA-coated tube.
Spin 750xg, 4ºC, 5 min; remove supernatant.
Wash with 500ul NID-2RI; spin 750xg, 4ºC, 5 min; remove supernatant.
Add 100ul NIB-2RI, incubate 5 min on ice to permeabilize.
Spin 750xg, 4ºC, 5 min; remove supernatant using P20.
Resuspend in 50ul NI-RI (1200ul NI + 3ul Enzymatic RI).
Count nuclei: Mix 2.5ul cells, 7.5ul NI-RI, and 10ul Trypan blue. Use BioRad TC20 or hemocytometer. Multiply count by 4 (or divide TC20 count per mL by 1000) to get count per ul.

steps.title: Perform ATAC Tn5 Transposition
steps.instruction: Tagment the chromatin using Tn5 transposase.

substeps.instruction: Calculate total reactions (N) based on 10,000 cells per reaction. Prepare 1x TB buffer: 0.2M Tris-acetate, 5M K-acetate, 1M Mg-acetate, 100% DMF, H2O, PIC, and Enzymatic RI (volumes scaled by N).
Assemble transposome: Mix 1x SeqWell Tn5, dilution buffer, and annealed adapter (volumes scaled by N). Use 0.6ul per 10,000 cells.
Adjust cell volume to 50ul using NI-RI.
Add 42.5 x N ul of 1xTB to cells; incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Add 2.5 x N ul of assembled Tn5; mix by pipetting.
Add 500ul NID-2RI; spin 750xg, RT, 5 min; remove supernatant.
Wash with 500ul NI-2RI; spin 750xg, RT, 5 min; remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 60ul NI-2RI.
Pool reactions for a sample: add 300ul NID-2RI per 7 PCR tubes; spin 750xg, 5 min, RT in BSA-coated tube.

steps.title: Optional PolyAdenylation
steps.instruction: Perform for hematopoietic samples (PBMCs, HSCs) to improve RNA capture.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 500ul NI-2RI, spin 750xg, 5 min, RT.
Add 200ul NID-2RI, spin 1000xg, 5 min, RT; remove supernatant.
Add 200ul NI-2RI, mix by inverting; spin 1000xg, 5 min, RT; remove supernatant.
Resuspend to a total volume of 60ul NI-2RI.

steps.title: Hybridization Round 1
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of cellular barcoding.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Round 1 oligo plates to RT (~23ºC) and spin down.
Prepare Hybridization buffer (H2O, 10x T4 ligase buffer, Enzymatic RI, SUPERase RI, 7.5% BSA).
Mix cells in NI-2RI with hybridization buffer in a BSA-coated reservoir.
Transfer 45ul of mixture to Round 1 plates using a 12-channel pipette; mix 5-7x. Change tips between columns.
Seal and shake at 300rpm for 25 min at RT (23ºC).
Add 10ul Blocking oligo 1 to each well; mix thoroughly. Seal and shake at 300rpm for 15 min at RT.

steps.title: Hybridization Round 2
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of cellular barcoding.

substeps.instruction: Pool Round 1 contents: Use 12-channel pipette (70ul) to eject each row into a BSA-coated reservoir; mix 4-5x.
Transfer 55ul of pooled mixture to Round 2 oligo plates; mix each row. Shake at 300rpm for 25 min at RT.
Add 10ul Blocking oligo 2 to each well; mix thoroughly. Seal and shake at 300rpm for 15 min at RT.

steps.title: Hybridization Round 3
steps.instruction: Perform the third round of cellular barcoding.

substeps.instruction: Pool Round 2 contents: Use 12-channel pipette (80ul) to eject each row into a BSA-coated reservoir; mix 4-5x.
Transfer 65ul of pooled mixture to Round 3 oligo plates; mix each row. Shake at 300rpm for 25 min at RT.
Add 10ul Blocking oligo 3 to each well; mix thoroughly. Seal and shake at 300rpm for 15 min at RT.

steps.title: Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate the barcodes to the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Pool all well contents into a 15mL BSA-coated conical tube (~7-14mL total).
Spin 750xg, 5 min, RT. Discard supernatant.
Add 1mL NI-2RI; spin 750xg, 5 min, RT. Discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 80ul NI-2RI.
Mix sample with 320ul ligation mix (H2O, Enzymatic RI, SUPERase RI, 10x T4 ligase buffer, T4 ligase 400U/ml, 7.5% BSA).
Aliquot 50ul to 8 PCR tubes; shake at 300rpm for 30 min at RT.
Pool samples in BSA-coated tube; spin 750xg, 5 min, RT; discard supernatant.
Spin again at 750xg, 5 min, RT.

steps.title: Reverse Crosslinking and Pull-down
steps.instruction: Digest proteins and isolate barcoded nucleic acids using beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in NI-2RI (goal: ~2000 nuclei/ul).
Aliquot into sub-pools (max 25k cells for 1 plate, 100k for 2 plates). Bring volume to 50ul with NI-2RI.
Add 50ul 2x RCB, 2ul proteinase K (20mg/mL), and 2ul SUPERase RI. Incubate at 55ºC for 1 hour (lid 65ºC).
Mix with 2.5ul 100mM PMSF in IPA; incubate at RT for 10 min.
Prepare buffers: 2x BW, 1x BW-T, and STE. Add SUPERase RI to create 2x BW/RI, 1x BW-T/RI, and 1x STE/RI.
Prepare beads: Mix 10xN ul MyOne C1 Dynabeads with 100xN ul 1xBW-T. Wash twice with 100xN ul BW-T (no RI), then once with 100xN ul BW-T/RI. Resuspend in 110xN ul 2x BW/RI.
Add 100ul washed beads to each sample; nutate at RT for 60 min.
Place on magnet; transfer supernatant (ATAC fragments) to a new tube.
Wash cDNA/RNA-bound beads 3x with 100ul 1xBW-T/RI, then once with 100ul 1xSTE/RI.

steps.title: RNA Library Template Switching
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription and template switching on beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Template switch mix: H2O, 50% PEG 6000, 5x SMART RT buffer, 1x Ficoll PM-400, 10mM dNTPs, RNase inhibitor, 100mM TSO, and Maxima H Minus RT.
Remove supernatant from beads; resuspend in 55ul Template switch mix.
Rotate/nutate at RT for 30 min.
Incubate at 42ºC for 90 min, shaking at 300rpm. Flick tubes to resuspend beads at 0, 30, 60, and 90 min.

steps.title: ATAC Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Clean and amplify the ATAC-seq libraries.

substeps.instruction: Spin ATAC supernatant at 13,000rpm for 1 min; discard flowthrough.
Wash with 750ul PE Wash Buffer; spin 13,000rpm for 1 min; discard flowthrough.
Spin 13,000rpm for 1 min to capture excess buffer.
Add 11ul EB to column; incubate 1 min; spin 13,000rpm for 1 min to elute.
Add another 11ul EB; incubate 1 min; spin again (total ~20ul eluate).
Mix ~20ul sample with 29ul PCR mix (NEBnext 2x mastermix, P7 primer, H2O) and 1ul IDT8_i5_xx primer. Run 5 cycles: 72ºC 5min, then [98ºC 30s, 65ºC 30s, 72ºC 60s] x 5.
Perform qPCR with 5ul sample and 10ul qPCR mix (NEBnext, Ad1.01, P7, SYBRgreen, H2O). Calculate 0.33 Ct.
Run additional PCR cycles (N = 0.33 Ct) on the remaining 45ul sample.
Clean with Qiagen MinElute DNA kit (225-250ul binding buffer), elute in 20ul EB (2x 10ul).
Mix cDNA sample with 100ul H2O; magnetize and discard supernatant; wash with 200ul STE.
Mix 50ul PCR mix (Kapa Hifi 2x, RNA PCR primer, P7 primer, H2O) with beads.
Run 5 cycles: 95ºC 3min, then [98ºC 20s, 65ºC 45s, 72ºC 3min] x 5.
Transfer supernatant to new PCR wells.
Perform qPCR with 2.5ul sample and 7.5ul qPCR mix (Kapa Hifi 2x, RNA PCR primer, P7 primer, EVAgreen, H2O). Calculate 0.33 Ct.
Run additional PCR cycles (N = 0.33 Ct) on the remaining ~50ul sample.
Purify with AMpure beads: 38ul (0.8x) for cell lines or 28.5ul (0.6x) for primary samples. Bind 5 min, wash 2x with 200ul 80% ethanol, dry 5 min, resuspend in 20.5ul EB, incubate 5 min, elute 20ul.

steps.title: cDNA Tagmentation and Indexing
steps.instruction: Tagment the amplified cDNA and add sequencing indices.

substeps.instruction: Quantify cDNA via BioAnalyzer. Dilute to 5ng/ul in ddH2O.
Assemble transposome: Mix 1x Tn5, dilution buffer, and annealed tagmentation adapter in glycerol. Incubate at RT for 30 min.
Mix 10ul 5ng/ul cDNA, 10ul H2O, 25ul 2x TD buffer (Tris pH 7.5, MgCl2, DMF), and 5ul assembled Tn5. Incubate at 55ºC for 5 min.
Purify with Qiagen column (250ul binding buffer), elute in 22ul EB.
Add 29ul post-tagmentation PCR mix (NEBnext 2x, P7 primer, H2O) and 1ul sample-specific IDT8_i5_xx primer. Run 7 cycles: 72ºC 5min, then [98ºC 30s, 65ºC 30s, 72ºC 60s] x 7.
Double AMpure purification: 1) 35ul beads (0.7x), elute in 50ul EB. 2) 35ul beads (0.7x), elute in 20ul EB.

steps.title: Final Library Quantification
steps.instruction: Assess and pool libraries for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Run cDNA libraries on BioAnalyzer/Tapestation to check for fragments < 250bp.
Quantify using Kapa Quant qPCR kit for Illumina.
Pool libraries to 4-10nM concentration.
